entities.name: Pierre-Louis Dietsch

entities.summary: Pierre-Louis-Philippe Dietsch was a French composer and conductor, perhaps best remembered for the much anthologized Ave Maria 'by' Jacques Arcadelt, which he loosely arranged from that composer's three part madrigal Nous voyons que les hommes.
